description: Defines the QpackInstructionDecoder class for decoding QPACK instructions in QUIC, including nested classes, enums, and private decoding state.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder
classes.description: Decodes QPACK instructions based on a specified language, notifying a delegate upon decoding or errors.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving decoded instructions or errors during decoding process.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Provides a data fragment to decode; returns success or failure.

methods.name: AtInstructionBoundary
methods.description: Checks if decoding is at an instruction boundary.

methods.name: varint2
methods.description: Returns the second decoded varint value.
